build_ray_executor_v2: build a Ray-based distributed executor using RayExecutorV2 for vLLM model inference across GPU nodes
create_ray_worker_handle: create a RayWorkerHandle dataclass instance to manage a Ray worker actor with rank, node_id, and bundle index
initialize_ray_worker_proc: initialize a RayWorkerProc worker process with deferred GPU assignment and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES setup
run_worker_health_monitor: run a background monitor thread that polls Ray ObjectRefs to detect dead worker processes
shutdown_ray_executor: shutdown the RayExecutorV2 executor, killing all Ray worker actors and closing message queues
